dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Hehe... It's good that you were able to come.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're glad to see you too, Jeht! There's so much we'd like to tell you, but... Hmm, where should we even begin?

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: I know, right? There's so much we all want to say, but now that we've met... Hehe, "where should we start," huh?

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: I've learned a phrase here in the tribe, and it goes something like "the closer your home, the more reticent your heart." And, y'know, it describes our situation perfectly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, is this tribe always so... er, eloquent?
